description: N17, the loop, not the judge's accuracy: the calibration run, before any real run. On seed 3001 it trains the peer (rw-peer), all five loop-free judges (rw-j20, rw-j10, rw-j05, rw-j025, rw-j0125) and the passenger pair (rw-b1 retrained twice, once with a passenger head). It re-measures the saved calibration models of N12 to N15 (from the n12_calib, n13_calib, n14_calib and n15_calib Drive folders) on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024. It first runs the setup checks with 16-bit training on; if any fails, it stops before training. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 30 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
